latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly add Korean subtitles to videos for Korean content creators.

- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for subtitle generation and editing
- Automatic Korean subtitle generation, with options to translate captions to English
- Fully cloud-based processing using remote GPU, typically returns 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes
- Environment setup with anonymous token; session maintained for batch or iterative editing
- Handles uploads, subtitle editing, aspect ratio changes, BGM/text overlays, previewing, and downloads via mapped actions
- Status messages and error handling for common cases (credits, file limits, unsupported types)
